exact_reference_returns.purpose: Resolve a disputed interpretation of original methods, measurements or figures.
reading_guide: Triage relevance to the current decision. Record why a source can be set aside. For a central claim read the original methods or figure, at the exact locator.
Extract the endpoint, sample, denominator, units, controls and conditions used. Keep the authors' findings, your inference, unseen pages and contrary evidence distinct.
Multiple interfaces can point to one publication. Compare the underlying samples before treating reports as independent. Unknown independence is a valid outcome.

Explain which comparison or action this evidence changes or supports keeping. If the disputed interpretation matters to that action, request a fresh reading of the original by an independent researcher.
exact_reference_returns.limitations: Record abstracts, partial originals and unavailable appendices as partial coverage.
